newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone, C&W jump on BT deal.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone, C&W jump on BT deal.

text.p: UK telecom shares jumped on Monday as BT's proposed $20 billion merger with MCI Communications renewed expectations for a wave of consolidation in the sector, dealers and analysts said.
By 0900 GMT, shares in Vodafone rose 7-1/2p to 244p, a two-month high, while shares in Cable & Wireless added 8-1/2p to 498p, a six-month high.
BT's linkup with America's MCI Corp, which will create the world's second largest telecom group, "increases the chances of a response from the likes of AT&T and Global One," said one analyst.
Global One is a joint venture between America's Sprint Corp, French Telecom and Deutsche Telekom.
"AT&T and Global One must be thinking about what they're going to do next," the analyst added.
Dealers noted market rumours last week that AT&T was contemplating a bid for Vodafone.
"AT&T is like a slumbering giant. This whole (BT) deal may bring Vodafone back into play," one dealer said.
